items.utterance_en: What's the area of a rectangle that has width of 5m and length of 7m?

function.name: draw_circle
function.description: Draw a circle based on the radius provided.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the radius. e.g. 'm' for meters, 'cm' for centimeters

items.utterance_en: What is the magnetic field at a point located at distance 'r' from a wire carrying current 'I'?

function.name: magnetic_field_intensity
function.description: Calculates the magnetic field intensity at a point located at a given distance from a current carrying wire

current.description: The current flowing through the wire in Amperes.

distance.description: The distance from the wire at which magnetic field intensity is required, in meters.

permeability.description: The permeability of free space, optional, default value is 4*pi*10^-7.

items.utterance_en: How much gas is generated from heating a 2 m³ closed chamber with air at a temperature of 25°C to 100°C?

function.name: thermodynamics.calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure.

items.utterance_en: How many sides does a hexagon have?

function.name: calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a given pressure.

substance.description: The chemical name of the substance.

pressure.description: The external pressure. Default is 1 atm (atmospheric pressure).

items.utterance_en: What is the mating process of Lions?

function.name: get_genetic_traits
function.description: Retrieve the dominant and recessive genetic traits for a given species.

species.description: The species to retrieve the genetic traits for.

dominant_trait.description: The dominant trait for the species.

recessive_trait.description: The recessive trait for the species.

items.utterance_en: How to solve the quadratic equation with coefficients 2, 3 and 4?

function.name: genetic_algorithm.optimize
function.description: Apply the genetic algorithm to optimize a function with multiple variables.

items.description: A list of constraints for the variables in the function.

population_size.description: The size of the population for the genetic algorithm.

mutation_rate.description: The rate of mutation for the genetic algorithm.

items.utterance_en: How to build a frontend interface for my e-commerce website?

function.name: create_Recommender_Model
function.description: This function is used to create a recommendation model using a given user data and an algorithm type

user_data.description: A data frame of user ratings. Rows represent users, columns represent items, and entries represent user ratings for items

algorithm.description: The algorithm to be used for creating the recommendation model. Collaborative filtering, content-based filtering and hybrid filtering.

matrix_factorization.description: Optional parameter to indicate whether matrix factorization should be used. Default is False.

items.utterance_en: Calculate the compounded interest for a principal amount of $10000, with a annual interest rate of 5% for a period of 3 years.

function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
function.description: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment given the loan amount, loan term and annual interest rate.

annual_interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. e.g. 3.5 for 3.5%

items.utterance_en: What is the largest planet in the universe?

function.name: space.star_info
function.description: Retrieve information about a particular star in the universe.

information.description: The type of information needed about the star.

items.utterance_en: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

items.utterance_en: What are the primary triads in the key of C major?

function.name: music_analysis.find_common_chords
function.description: Find the most common chords in a specific genre of music.

genre.description: The genre of music to analyze.

num_chords.description: The number of top common chords to return.

items.utterance_en: Who won the championship of the World Series in 2020?

function.name: sports.ranking.get_champion
function.description: Retrieve the champion of a specific sports event for a given year.

year.description: The year of the sports event.

function.name: sports_ranking.get_top_ranked
function.description: Get the current top ranked athlete for a specific sport.

sport.description: The sport to get the ranking for.

year.description: The year for which the ranking is required.

items.utterance_en: What is the current time in Sydney, Australia?

function.name: get_local_time
function.description: Retrieve the local time for a specific city.

location.description: The city to get the local time for.

format.description: The format of the time to be retrieved, either 12 hours or 24 hours.

timezone.description: The timezone of the location. If left blank, the function will default to the city's local timezone.
